item.title: Crowds pack for SF's Chinese New Year Parade, cheer on Olympian, Grand Marshal Eileen Gu; drone show
item.description: Tens of thousands of people turned out for San Francisco's Chinese New Year Parade Saturday. It's the largest Lunar New Year celebration outside of Asia. What got many people really excited though --the Grand Marshal for this year's parade--San Francisco native and Olympic gold medalist Eileen Gu. And there was a surprise drone show!

item.description: Here's a look at some of the most memorable moments of the San Francisco Chinese New Year Parade as thousands flock to the city to watch the streets fill with dancing, floats and so much more.

item.description: Jennifer Runyon, the actress known for her roles in "Ghostbusters" and "Charles in Charge," has died.

item.title: Rihanna's Los Angeles-area mansion struck by gunfire; woman arrested, police say
item.description: Rihanna's Los Angeles area mansion was struck by gunfire while the singer was home, according to the LAPD and sources with knowledge of the investigation.

item.title: International Women's Day brings protests, marches in Bay Area: 'Never stop fighting'
item.description: A call to action for women across the Bay Area and the world. International Women's Day events happened on Sunday, as activists called for equal pay, reproductive rights and justice for women everywhere.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: Supply concerns have driven crude and gasoline higher as the war ensnares major oil-producing countries and hinders exports from the Persian Gulf.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Patchy fog tonight, breezier and cooler Monday
item.description: Patchy fog will develop overnight and clear quickly tomorrow morning. Monday afternoon will feature breezier and cooler temps with low 60s at the coast to the mid 70s inland.

item.title: Dublin teachers prepared to go strike Monday after no deal reached, school district says
item.description: Teachers with the Dublin Unified School District are expected to go on strike on Monday after no deal was reached this weekend, the district said.
